title: Rav Mesharshiya, son of Rav Hiyya

paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya, son of Rav Hiyya.
He is mentioned in Bava Batra 82a, after the words of Rav Ashi. Perhaps it should read "son of Rav Aha," and "Hiyya" arose from the word "Aha."[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s “after the words of Rav Ashi” locates this mention in the text; it does not itself date Mesharshiya after Rav Ashi.

Hyman tentatively proposes Aha in place of Hiyya and suggests the direction Aha→Hiyya for the presumed corruption. His “perhaps” is preserved; the heading and father’s name remain unchanged. The printed פב. is rendered Bava Batra 82a.
